title: WatchTriggeredPayload
description: watch.watch.triggered v1 (OpenVibe.Watch, plan T18; the dossier's watch.triggered, named with three segments as every event type is here — the repo's event-type pattern requires at least three): a watch's condition fired. OpenVibe.Network turns it into a WATCH_TRIGGERED notification for payload.recipient (mirrors deals.watch.matched). Envelope: subject { type: watch, id: <watch_id> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:watch.

recipient.description: The watch owner's user subject id: who is notified.

value.description: The value that fired the condition.

previous_value.description: The previous observation's value; null when there was none.
